workflow: Compare observed central taurine exposure with effective nominal bath ranges, preserving age, units and dispersion.
evidence_basis: Results associated with Figure 3 contrast bath concentrations ≤100 μM, 300 μM, 1 mM and 3 mM. The outcome at lower concentrations was postsynaptic currents.

Methods: “at higher taurine doses”. The low-concentration nonresponder rule selected cells responsive at a higher concentration; a nonsignificant group outcome is not a universal biological threshold.
